user.description: Shared settings for this install, plus the first person who receives briefings. Add more people later with Add person.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Entities, voices and greeting details used to build this person's segments.

data_description.pronunciations: How to say words and names in this person's own briefings, as written and spoken. Every person's phonetic name already applies in all briefings.
data_description.commute_drive_sensor: Travel-time sensor (minutes) for driving to this person's work zone.
data_description.commute_transit_sensor: Travel-time sensor (minutes) for public transit to this person's work zone.
data_description.commute_drive_return_sensor: Optional. Travel-time sensor (minutes) for driving home in the evening, such as Google Maps Travel Time set to a departure time. Adds the trip home and a round-trip total.
data_description.commute_transit_return_sensor: Optional. Travel-time sensor (minutes) for taking transit home in the evening. Adds the trip home and a round-trip total.
data_description.scripture_entity: A JW Library daily text sensor, or a text helper with the day's text.
data_description.host_personas: Who hosts the briefing: greeting, weather, agenda, commute and closing. Pick several to get a different one each day. Leave empty to use the host voice and personality below.
data_description.reader_personas: Who reads the daily text and daily encouragement. Pick several to get a different one each day. Leave empty to use the scripture voice and personality below.

data_description.name: Used by the announce action and in entity ids.
data_description.description: What the announcement is for, what the slide should show and what should be said. For example: "AI background of a cosy front door at dusk, Alex and Sam in two circles, 'Welcome home' across the top", or "use the uploaded image as is, with Sam's photo in the bottom-right corner like a profile badge".
data_description.wording: Exactly as written speaks the Message. Written by the persona lets the AI write the words from the description, in the persona's character.
data_description.message: The words to speak when the wording is exactly as written.
data_description.freshness: Static is built once. Daily is rebuilt every day at the rebuild time, with a persona picked from your list.
data_description.personas: Who speaks. Static: one persona. Daily: one or more, a different one each day.
data_description.rebuild_time: Daily only: when the daily rebuild runs.
data_description.pictures: Up to 4 pictures from your local media. Say in the description how each is used.
data_description.output_format: Visual builds a slide and plays video on screens. Audio builds speech only.
data_description.target: The speaker or display it plays on when an automation or the Play button names no other. Pick a different one to test on from the announcement's device page.

init.title: CastStudio Options
init.description: Shared settings for every person. Edit each person's name, voice and commute on the person itself.

written.name: Written as
written.description: The word or name as it appears in text.

spoken.name: Spoken as
spoken.description: How it should be spelled out for the voice.

prebuild.name: Pre-build briefing
prebuild.description: Builds and stores a routine's segments, or the segments of all of a person's routines, without playing anything. For visual routines the stitched routine video and an audio copy are stored too.

person.name: Person
person.description: Person to pre-build for. Alone, builds the union of all of that person's routines; with a routine, picks which person's routine is meant.

routine.name: Routine
routine.description: Routine to pre-build. Give a person or a routine, or both.

play.name: Play briefing
play.description: Plays a routine now from fresh stored segments, building anything missing or stale live first.

person.name: Person
person.description: Person whose routine to play. Needed only when more than one person has a routine with this name.

target.name: Target media player
target.description: Plays on this media player instead of the person's output device.

skip_played.name: Skip played segments
skip_played.description: If on, plays only the segments this routine has not yet played in the person's briefing day. When everything has been heard, a short "That's everything" line plays.

rebuild_announcement.name: Rebuild Announcement
rebuild_announcement.description: Builds an announcement again now. Creative wording gets new words, and visual announcements a new slide.

announcement.name: Announcement
announcement.description: Name of the announcement to rebuild.

announce.name: Play Announcement
announce.description: Plays an announcement now, video on a screen and audio otherwise. A CastStudio briefing playing on the target pauses and resumes after it.

announcement.name: Announcement
announcement.description: Name of the announcement to play.

target.name: Target Media Player
target.description: Media player to play the announcement on. Defaults to the announcement's Play on setting.
